title: SAADE-AUA: Scenario-Adaptive Audio Deepfake Evaluation on Ukrainian Speech
description:
Source code for Scenario-Adaptive Audio Deepfake Evaluation (SAADE) on the Ukrainian AUA corpus.

The project evaluates pretrained synthetic speech detectors (AASIST, AASIST-L, Wav2Vec2) across 21 acoustic scenarios: a clean baseline plus noise, MP3 compression, reverberation and low-pass filtering, each at five severity levels. No models are trained; all detectors are used with their original pretrained weights.

The repository contains the five-step evaluation pipeline (text-matched REAL-TTS pair generation with Piper, full scenario evaluation, ONNX/PyTorch reference parity audit, repeat-padding correction, and a frozen one-time hidden test protocol), dataset audits, manuscript preparation scripts and archived development releases.

Audio recordings, model weights, predictions and hidden-test results are not included. SHA-256 checksums for all files are listed in CODE_MANIFEST_SHA256.json.
